description: The GD intervention consisted of six two-hour interactive workshop sessions with four participants each.
title: Group discussion workshop design: experience sharing, role-play, peer feedback, and instructor guidance

description: The treatment followed Tuckman's (1965) four stages of group development: Forming, Storming, Norming, and Performing, which the article says \"have a great impact and relevance for the study of the classroom context\".
title: GDOI treatment structured through Tuckman's four stages of group development
